title: coelogyne globosa
intro: Coelogyne globosa, commonly known as the globosa orchid, is a species of flowering orchid native to tropical Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and aiding in the treatment of fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Coelogyne globosa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
